title: x-only polynomial lower bound for k^2 (Theorem B)
question: Theorem B: Let E/F_p short Weierstrass, P of prime order r. If g in F_p[X] satisfies g(x(kP)) = k^2 mod p for 1 <= k <= (r-1)/2, then deg g >= (r-5)/6.
rationale: Registered by PI from round-5 runs after PI reproduction of numerics.
